description: The paper and the metadata table give different lesion counts. The paper's Table 1 reports 2,122 scans with kidney tumours, 1,472 with liver tumours and 361 with pancreatic tumours. In the table, the lesion-instance count is above 0 in 2,144, 1,470 and 1,111 scans. Figure 1's caption reports 4,424 kidney tumours, and the table's kidney instance counts sum to 5,378. In the 232 cases checked, the kidney lesion mask is non-empty in 78 scans and the table lists a kidney lesion for 77. The exception is BDMAP_00000112, whose mask holds a small lesion (36 voxels, 35.5 mm³) that its report and table row do not mention.
inspectedScope: All 9,262 rows of the metadata table compared with Table 1 and Figure 1 of the paper; kidney lesion masks for 232 cases.
detection: Counts recomputed from every row of AbdomenAtlas3.0MiniWithMeta.csv; masks opened with nibabel for the 232 local cases.
impact: A cohort selected from the table (for example "scans with a kidney lesion") differs from one selected from the masks or from the paper's numbers. The pancreatic numbers differ threefold.
handling: Decide which source defines a lesion for your use, and select cases from the masks when the mask is what is being learned. The provider does not explain the difference.

description: The organ volumes and lesion numbers in the metadata table are not measured from the masks. The metadata script reads them back out of the structured report text with pattern matching. The 'largest lesion' columns take the first lesion the report lists, and the script then writes 0 wherever a lesion value is missing. BDMAP_00005266 has no report at all, yet its lesion counts, sizes and volumes read 0.
inspectedScope: The metadata script at commit d064db1, and all 9,262 rows of the metadata table.

evidence.locator: Row BDMAP_00005266: structured and narrative report empty, lesion columns 0.0
evidence.note: Only the scan with no report is counted; other missing values set to 0 cannot be told apart from true zeros.

detection: Reading parse_radiology_report, parse_lesions and fill_nan_in_specific_columns in ExtractComprehensiveMedatadaReports.py, then checking the table.
impact: A 0 in a lesion column means "no lesion found in the report text", which includes "no report". Values inherit any error in the report text.
handling: Treat the table as a summary of the reports. Recompute volumes and sizes from the masks where precision matters, and exclude BDMAP_00005266 from report-based work.

description: The metadata table's shape column does not give the shape of the released CT files. In all 232 cases checked, the released volume is smaller than the listed shape along at least one axis and never larger; the spacing column matches the file in all 232.
inspectedScope: The first image and mask tarballs, 232 cases (BDMAP_00000001 to BDMAP_00000232), opened on 2026-09-30.

evidence.locator: shape and spacing columns of the metadata table compared with the headers of the 232 ct.nii.gz files in the first image tarball
evidence.note: All 232 of the 232 cases checked; the other 9,030 were not opened.

detection: NIfTI headers of ct.nii.gz compared with the shape and spacing columns.
impact: Code that allocates arrays or computes coverage from the shape column gets the wrong size. The column cannot be used to count slices.
handling: Read shapes from the NIfTI headers.

description: Mask files do not all store their values the same way. Across the release, masks are stored as 0/1, as 0/255, or as signed bytes −128/127 with a header scale that maps them to 0/1. In the 232 cases checked, 14 kidney lesion masks are stored as −128/127 and read as 0 and 1.00000006 once scaled; the kidney_left and kidney_right masks there are all stored as 0/1 (7 of them empty).
inspectedScope: Whole release: every mask tarball listed by the Kidney-VLM project on 2026-09-23 (the log of that check was not kept). Re-checked for the kidney masks of the 232 cases in the first tarball.
detection: nibabel: unscaled stored values compared with scaled values.
impact: Reading the raw integers treats background as −128 and a lesion as 127, and a threshold such as "value == 1" misses the lesion.
handling: Load masks with a reader that applies the NIfTI scale and offset (for example nibabel get_fdata) and threshold at 0.5.

description: In 56 of the 232 cases checked, at least one mask file carries a different header orientation from its CT: a zero origin and, in most of them, flipped axis directions. 132 files are affected. The aorta mask accounts for 51 of the cases; in 8 cases 8 to 13 files are affected, among them kidney_left and kidney_right in BDMAP_00000152, BDMAP_00000181 and BDMAP_00000197. The arrays still have the CT's shape, and by array index they sit on the right tissue: the median CT value inside is 25 to 468 HU for these aorta masks and 35 to 194 HU for these kidney masks.
inspectedScope: The first image and mask tarballs, 232 cases (BDMAP_00000001 to BDMAP_00000232), opened on 2026-09-30.

evidence.locator: affine of every mask file compared with its ct.nii.gz
evidence.note: 56 of the 232 cases checked; the rest of the release was not opened.

detection: NIfTI affines of every mask compared with the CT; CT values sampled inside the aorta and kidney masks by array index (other mismatched files were not checked this way).
impact: Tools that place masks by world coordinates (resampling, most viewers) show these masks mirrored or shifted away from the anatomy.
handling: Pair masks with the CT by array index, or copy the CT header onto the masks, after checking that shapes match.

description: The CT file headers checked hold no patient names or ID numbers, but some keep acquisition times. In 8 of the 232 CTs checked, the header's description field holds a scan time ("Time=..."). One of them, BDMAP_00000186, also keeps the full acquisition date, both there and in a header extension written by the dicm2nii converter, which also copies the series number, scanner manufacturer and software version.
inspectedScope: The first image and mask tarballs, 232 cases (BDMAP_00000001 to BDMAP_00000232), opened on 2026-09-30. Only the NIfTI header text fields (descrip, aux_file, intent_name, db_name) and header extensions were read; image content was not examined.

evidence.locator: NIfTI header text fields and extensions of the 232 ct.nii.gz files in the first image tarball
evidence.note: 8 of the 232 CTs checked, one of them with a full date; the rest of the release was not opened.

detection: nibabel: every non-empty header text field and header extension printed and read.
impact: Exact dates are usually removed when data are de-identified. Their presence in a released file means de-identification cannot be assumed complete without a statement from the provider.
handling: Strip header text fields and extensions before redistributing CTs, and ask the provider how the scans were de-identified.

description: The paper describes 240 enhanced reports that merge human notes with the generated reports (209 from TotalSegmentator clinical notes, 31 from the authors' radiologists). The metadata table has 117: the radiologist note, fusion structured report and fusion narrative report columns are filled in the same 117 rows.
inspectedScope: All 9,262 rows of the metadata table compared with section 3.3 of the paper.
detection: Non-empty cells counted per report column.
impact: Work that expects the 240 enhanced reports finds fewer than half in the table.
handling: Use the 117 in the table. pdf_reports.zip was not opened, so whether it holds more is not known.

description: The Hugging Face dataset card states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The LICENSE file of the RadGPT GitHub repository, which hosts the download script, states CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for "this work". The two differ on whether adaptations may be shared.
inspectedScope: Dataset card at revision 122e04f and LICENSE at commit d064db1.
impact: Under the no-derivatives licence, sharing adapted material such as preview images or modified masks would not be permitted.
handling: Ask the provider which licence covers the images, masks and reports before redistributing anything derived from them.

description: The kidney masks and the kidney lesion mask are separate files and can overlap. In BDMAP_00000061 the right-kidney mask covers most of the 9.5 cm lesion, so the kidney outline runs around the lesion in every view.
inspectedScope: The atlas preview of BDMAP_00000061 (axial, zoomed axial, coronal and sagittal views through the lesion). Other cases were not inspected for overlap.

evidence.locator: BDMAP_00000061, kidney and kidney lesion masks
evidence.note: One case seen in a preview; this is not a count across the release.

detection: Seen in the preview rendering of both masks on the CT.
impact: A kidney volume taken from the kidney mask can include the lesion, and adding kidney and lesion volumes counts the overlap twice.
handling: Subtract the lesion mask from the kidney mask when a lesion-free kidney volume is needed.
